verdict.rationale: A database platform could plausibly ship background automations such as scheduled jobs or recurring tasks, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no product-native scheduler, recurring job, or autonomous background automation. The 'automating branching' mention relies on the user's own CI tooling, and the MCP integration lets an agent act on demand rather than run on a recurring schedule; both are adjacent, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
